{{Quote|If TIE forces were allowed to operate on their own terms, the Alliance starfighter forces would surely vanish from space.<br />We do not allow the Empire to operate on its own terms, and so we keep an edge. Read this report and hone that edge.|Introduction to Bakki Sourthol's report on TIE Fighters|<ref name="TIE">{{JournalCite|10|Alliance Intelligence Report: TIE Fighters}}</ref>}}
[[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] '''Bakki Sourthol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Officer/Legends|officer]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], flying a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] through the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] as the [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]. Sourthol sometimes worked along with special operations and intelligence, writing reports on the threats posed by the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] [[Yansan]] and by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Affable and animated, Sourthol was also good at playing [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of the reasons Intell has asked me to contribute to Yansan's dossier is because of my encounter with him in the Fakir sector: he actually attempted to disable some of our transports while we were still inside!|Lieutenant Commander Bakki Sourthol, Alliance to Restore the Republic|<ref name="AIR" />}}
Bakki Sourthol, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] because his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] political beliefs prevented him from entering the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. An experienced [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Sourthol commanded an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] Squadron in the [[Bakchou arm]] of [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] as a member of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]. His callsign was [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]].<ref name="CP" /> He also became a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] working for Special Operations.<ref name="AIR" />

During his service in the Alliance, Sourthol identified [[Yansan]], a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]], trying to disable Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transports]] with several Rebels on board, including Sourthol himself. Yansan was stopped before he could finish the task, but he managed to escape. During this event, Sourthol noticed that Yansan had a limp, preferring the left leg.<ref name="AIR" />

On [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], due to some events in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]], Sourthol obtained important information about other threats to the Rebel Alliance. Due to this, he was temporarily relieved from his duties on Fakir so he could report to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. Sourthol wrote about Yansan and other threats. During this time, he also worked along with Lieutenants [[Anson Blazer]], [[Deeve]] and [[Tura Raftican]], and Special Agent [[Tay Vanis]].<ref name="AIR" />

Later, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Bakki Sourthol of the [[Red Squadron]] wrote a brief report on the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of starfighters used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Although it was an Intelligence Report, it was not restricted to Intel agents. Sourthol recognized that his report was uncomprehensive, and suggested another, more extensive report by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to complete the research.<ref name="TIE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Clear skies!|Introduction to Bakki Sourthol's report on TIE Fighters|<ref name="TIE" />}}
Sourthol was a friendly, cheerful and fearless man and a mean [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] player.<ref name="CP" /> He was also an excellent pilot, an observant Intelligence officer<ref name="AIR" /> and an expert in military technology. He was familiar with the tactics and history of TIE technology. While writing a report on them, he used ancient military proverbs as epigraph to some sections.<ref name="TIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sourthol first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', first published in the [[1988]] and then reprinted along with other material in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]'' in [[1994]]. He was then mentioned in further role-playing supplements, including ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' ([[1995]]). In ''Star Wars Campaign Pack'', his hair is described as "fair" but a graphic depiction of Sourthol by artist [[Mike Vilardi]] in ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' shows him with apparent dark hair.

''[[Alliance Intelligence Report: TIE Fighters]]'' (published in [[1996]] in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' #10]]) presented as a report written by Sourthol, apparently is a document written in times of the Rebel Alliance. However, Sourthol says that Wedge Antilles' report is available through the [[Ministry of Education]], suggesting that at this point Sourthol's party held control over official institutions, and thus that the report was written in times of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
